🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. where —— 条件选择/防除零保护
    where((ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20) > 0), multiply(abs(add(divide(AdjOpen, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), divide(AdjClose, AdjOpen))), divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20))), multiply(divide(subtract(ts_ema(AdjClose, 10), ts_ema(AdjClose, 30)), ts_ema(AdjClose, 30)), clip(divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20)), 0.5, 2)))
  2. 2. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20)
  3. 3. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)
  4. 4. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(abs(add(divide(AdjOpen, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), divide(AdjClose, AdjOpen))), divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20)))
  5. 5. abs —— 取绝对值
    abs(add(divide(AdjOpen, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), divide(AdjClose, AdjOpen)))
  6. 6. add —— 加法
    add(divide(AdjOpen, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), divide(AdjClose, AdjOpen))
  7. 7. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(AdjOpen, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1))
  8. 8. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)
  9. 9. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(AdjClose, AdjOpen)
  10. 10. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20))
  11. 11. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(Volume, 20)
  12. 12. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(divide(subtract(ts_ema(AdjClose, 10), ts_ema(AdjClose, 30)), ts_ema(AdjClose, 30)), clip(divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20)), 0.5, 2))
  13. 13. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(subtract(ts_ema(AdjClose, 10), ts_ema(AdjClose, 30)), ts_ema(AdjClose, 30))
  14. 14. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(ts_ema(AdjClose, 10), ts_ema(AdjClose, 30))
  15. 15. ts_ema —— 指数移动平均
    ts_ema(AdjClose, 10)
  16. 16. ts_ema —— 指数移动平均
    ts_ema(AdjClose, 30)
  17. 17. ts_ema —— 指数移动平均
    ts_ema(AdjClose, 30)
  18. 18. clip —— 裁剪到区间[下限,上限]
    clip(divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20)), 0.5, 2)
  19. 19. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20))
  20. 20. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(Volume, 20)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 high_resvol：style_gate_resvol_high > 0
  2. 计算 vol_factor：vol_ratio.clip(lower=0.5, upper=2.0)
  3. 计算 ema_short：close.ewm(span=10, adjust=False).mean()
  4. 计算 ema_long：close.ewm(span=30, adjust=False).mean()
  5. 计算 slow_trend：(ema_short - ema_long) / ema_long
  6. 计算 slow_trend_adjusted：slow_trend * vol_factor
  7. 计算 total_ret：overnight_ret + intraday_ret
  8. 计算 fast_impact：np.abs(total_ret) * vol_ratio
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_crossover_vol_impact_trend_gated(df): df_copy = df.copy() high_resvol = df_copy["style_gate_resvol_high"] > 0 is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20) vol_factor = vol_ratio.clip(lower=0.5, upper=2.0) ema_short = df_copy["close"].ewm(span=10, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() ema_long = df_copy["close"].ewm(span=30, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() slow_trend = (ema_short - ema_long) / ema_long slow_trend_adjusted = slow_trend * vol_factor overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"]) total_ret = overnight_ret + intraday_ret fast_impact = np.abs(total_ret) * vol_ratio df_copy["factor_crossover_vol_impact_trend_gated"] = np.where(high_resvol, fast_impact, slow_trend_adjusted) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_crossover_vol_impact_trend_gated"]
